steps.say: $\frac{1}{2}$ means "one half", so the test is whether the fraction is above, below or exactly at one half. Writing it on the same denominator: $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{[[den]]/2}{[[den]]}$, and comparing gives $\frac{[[num]]}{[[den]]} [[comp]] \frac{1}{2}$.
As a decimal check, $\frac{[[num]]}{[[den]]} \approx [[dec]]$, and one half is 0.5.

answer: So it is **[[word]]** than one half.
